description: Single-agent skill lab - HELD-OUT TEST set (disjoint from evolve). Benefits-heavy, all answerable via lookup_company_policy / lookup_benefits. expected_answer is ground truth for correctness scoring (score_correctness.py).

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave does a secondary caregiver get?
questions.expected_answer: 8 weeks for a secondary caregiver (16 weeks for primary).

questions.question: Does the company match my 401k contributions, and by how much?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a 4% company match, fully vested after 1 year.

questions.question: If I leave after six months, do I keep the 401k match?
questions.expected_answer: No - the match is vested only after 1 year, so leaving at 6 months means you don't keep it.

questions.question: Is my child's orthodontia (braces) covered by our plan?
questions.expected_answer: Yes - orthodontia is covered at 50% up to a $2,000 lifetime maximum.

questions.question: What's the benefit for eye exams and glasses?
questions.expected_answer: Annual eye exam covered; $200 frame allowance every 2 years.

questions.question: How much does the company put into an HSA for family coverage?
How much of my health premium do I pay versus the company?
questions.expected_answer: The company covers 80% of the employee premium (you pay ~20%); 50% for dependents.

questions.question: What's the out-of-pocket maximum for a family on the PPO?
Can I get a work-related course reimbursed, and up to how much?
questions.expected_answer: Yes - tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year for job-related courses (manager pre-approval, grade B or better).

questions.question: How many therapy sessions does the employee assistance program cover?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 8 counseling sessions per issue per year (plus a 24/7 hotline).

questions.question: What's the daily per-diem for meals when I travel for work?
Do I need a receipt for a $30 taxi ride?
questions.expected_answer: Yes - receipts are required for any expense over $25.

questions.question: Can you list our paid company holidays?
questions.expected_answer: 11 paid holidays: New Year's Day, MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Wed+Thu of Thanksgiving week, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve.

questions.question: How many days off do I get for the death of a sibling?
questions.expected_answer: 5 paid days (a sibling is immediate family).

questions.question: Can I work four 10-hour days instead of five 8-hour days?
questions.expected_answer: Yes - compressed work weeks like four 10-hour days are allowed with manager approval.

questions.question: How many vacation days do I get a year?
questions.expected_answer: 20 PTO days per year, accrued monthly.

questions.question: How many sick days am I given annually?
How many unused PTO days can roll into next year?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days roll over.
